chunks: Ali ibn Muhammad ibn Abdullah, from Ahmad ibn Abu Abdullah, from his father, from Abdullah ibn al-Mughira, from Musa ibn Bakr, from Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him), who said:
The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) used to say: 'Among the causes that necessitate the forgiveness of the Lord, Blessed and Exalted, is feeding food.'
ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual benefit of feeding food according to the Prophet?
ai.summary: In *Al-Kafi*, Shaykh al-Kulayni records this chain linking Imam al-Rida (AS) to the Prophet (PBUH), emphasizing that feeding the hungry is not merely charity but a decisive cause (*mujibat*) for divine forgiveness. This hadith underscores the Shia emphasis on *sadaqah* as a spiritual mechanism for cleansing sins, aligning with the concept of *kaffarah* (expiation) through tangible acts of generosity.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Muhammad Bin Abdullah, from Ahmad Bin Abu Abdullah, from his father, from Abdullah Bin Al Mugheira, from Musa Bin Bakr, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> was saying: ‘From the Obligatory Forgiveness of the Lord<sup>azwj</sup> Blessed and High, is feeding of the food’.
en.sarwar: 11. Ali ibn Muhammad ibn ‘Abd Allah has narrated from Ahmad ibn abu ‘Abd Allah from his father from ‘Abd Allah ibn al-Mughirah from Musa ibn Bakr who has said the following: “Abu al-Hassan, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that the Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, would say, ‘Of the reasons for the Lord, the Most Blessed, the most High, to grant forgiveness is one’s serving food.’”
